name: screenrig
description: Free, agent-driven digital signage. Your AI agent puts images, videos, menu boards and live apps on your TVs and kiosks, keeps every screen current from your docs, sheets and calendar, and checks what each one plays.

interface.longDescription: Use screenRIG to prepare content, pair Players, upload images and videos, and publish playlists to your screens. In environments that can run the bundled CLI, manage signage and eligible advertising workflows through conversation. Connect your screenRIG account to browse interactive screen, media, and playlist cards in supported MCP Apps hosts. Advertisers pay in US dollars by card or x402 machine payment through screenRIG; the plugin does not collect payment details or provide checkout or withdrawals.
defaultPrompt: Help me get a photo and video playing on my TV.
Show my playlists and the content in each one.
